concerns.text: The plan decides between Pearson and Spearman correlation based on Shapiro‑Wilk tests applied **separately to each variable** (anxiety_score and control_proxy). Scientific best practice requires assessing the normality of the **joint residuals** (or the bivariate distribution) when the goal is to test linear correlation; marginal normality does not guarantee that Pearson’s assumptions hold. This mismatch makes the statistical decision rule potentially invalid and constitutes a methodological flaw (violates AC‑008 which specifies testing normality of residuals).
